# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded.


# follow up on 20260411.md instructions
Fix the following plots and copy the replacements to the overleaf.
 - Add the muon-track rejection systematic uncertainty to the pp total systematic uncertainty plot as well as the total pp systematic uncertainty calculation. Remake the affected plots in the systematics section and appendix section and pp results.
 - For the difference pPb-pp systematic calculation plot it looks like PU is treated as an independed systematic for pp and pPb. Do not do this, PU should be treated as the same systematic uncertainty in the sense that we calculate difference variation = (pPb PU reject variation - pp PU reject variation) and compare this to the nominal difference. Update the difference calculation with this in mind. Propagate the change to remake the affected systematics plots, appendex and result plots.
 - Audit the way generally the difference systematic is being calculated. In general the difference systematic should be less than the systematics of pp and pPb added together since the variations should more or less move in the same way. For some bins it looks like their added simply together. Ensure we are calculating the nominal difference and variation differences and comparing these metrics instead of backhanding a calculation from the seperate system uncertainties.
 - Fig. 2 [still an issue] The pp/pPb/Pbp HLT trigger turn on plot is missing in the overleaf, or else is not being outputted correctly/has buggy implementation. Produce the plots for pp, pPb, Pbp in seperate files and call all the pdfs in the same figure in the overleaf. Do not attempt to put them on the same canvas.
